Ball Brain collects as little as possible. Here is what we store, why, and which rights you have.
Ved å bruke Ball Brain godtar du disse v: By using Ball Brain you accept these terms.
Spillernavn (kallenavn), land, valgt ava: Player name (nickname), country, chosen avatar, points, XP, level, records and trophies. We do not ask for your real name, email, phone number, location or pictures of you. When you play against others (1v1, club match, daily challenge or quiz night), your answers and the result are stored. If you are in a club, your membership is stored.
Kallenavn, land, poeng, klubbmedlemskap: Nickname, country, points, club memberships and results from matches, the daily challenge and quiz nights are stored with our database provider (Supabase) on servers in London (United Kingdom). The app signs you in anonymously, without email or password. If you turn on notifications, your device’s notification ID is also stored, and notifications are sent through Google (Firebase).
Hva som bare ligger på telefonen: What stays on your phone only
Avataren, XP, nivå, troféer, statistikke: The avatar, XP, level, trophies, statistics by topic, the list of questions you got wrong, your settings, whether Pro is turned on and your ad choices are kept only on your own device.
Når du blir med på en quizkveld, ser ver: When you join a quiz night, the host and the other players see your nickname and score. The host gets no other information about you. Quiz nights older than seven days are deleted on a rolling basis. Only share the code with people you want to join.
For at spillet skal fungere: å vise prof: To make the game work: to show your profile, keep track of progress and trophies, and show you on leaderboards and in matches against other players. The basis is that it is necessary to provide the service you use.
Andre spillere kan se kallenavn, land og: Other players can see nickname, country and points on leaderboards, in clubs you belong to, in 1v1, club matches and quiz nights. Choose a nickname that does not reveal who you are.
Annonsene i denne testutgaven er bare pl: The ads in this test version are only placeholders: no ad provider is connected and no data is shared. You choose whether to watch them. Ball Brain Pro is currently a test without payment, so no payment details are collected. Before real ads or purchases are introduced, we will update this text and ask for consent where required.
Appen er laget for fotballfans i alle al: The app is made for football fans of all ages. Children under 13 should use the app together with an adult. We do not collect more data about children than about others, and they should not enter real names.
Avatarene er tegnede figurer. Noen kan l: The avatars are drawn characters. Some may resemble real people and are used with consent.
Kartet vises fra data som ligger i appen: The map is shown from data stored in the app and needs no location from you. Pictures of players and stadiums come from Wikimedia Commons under a free licence (see Picture credits).
Vi selger ikke data og viser ikke person: We do not sell data and do not show personalised advertising. The database is run by Supabase and notifications by Google (Firebase). When the app checks for a new version, it contacts GitHub, which then sees your IP address as any website does. Error reporting and performance monitoring (planned through Firebase Crashlytics) will collect technical data, not your profile.
Du kan når som helst se, rette og slette: You can see, correct and delete your data at any time. “Delete all my data” in Settings removes everything from your phone and deletes your profile, points, matches and club memberships from the server. The anonymous sign-in ID, without name or email, may remain. You have the right to complain to the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet).
Data lagres så lenge du bruker appen. Sl: Data is stored for as long as you use the app. If you delete the app, what is on the phone disappears. Choose “Delete all my data” first if you also want it removed from the server.
Spørsmål om personvern kan sendes til ut: Questions about privacy can be sent to the developer via the contact address on the app’s page in the App Store and Google Play.
Ball Brain er et fotballquiz-spill for u: Ball Brain is a football quiz game for entertainment. You can use the app free of charge, also for quiz nights at the pub or in the supporters’ club. Ball Brain Pro is currently a test without payment. You must not try to cheat, break into the system or disturb other players.
Kallenavn skal ikke være krenkende, støt: Nicknames must not be offensive, abusive, unlawful or pretend to be someone else. We may change or remove nicknames and block users who break the rules.
Poeng, XP, nivåer og troféer har ingen p: Points, XP, levels and trophies have no monetary value and cannot be exchanged for anything. They may change if the game is adjusted.
Vi gjør vårt beste for at spørsmål og fa: We do our best to make questions and answers correct, but cannot promise everything is error-free. Please report mistakes.
Bilder av spillere og stadioner er brukt: Pictures of players and stadiums are used under a free licence from Wikimedia Commons. Ball Brain is not affiliated with or endorsed by any club, federation or player. Names and marks belong to their owners.
Appen leveres «som den er». Vi er ikke a: The app is provided “as is”. We are not liable for losses arising from use, as far as the law allows.
Vi kan oppdatere appen og disse vilkåren: We may update the app and these terms. For material changes we will notify you in the app.
Norsk lov gjelder. Tvister avgjøres ved: Norwegian law applies. Disputes are settled by Norwegian courts, without removing rights you have as a consumer.
